lines: Bakul Hiralal Shah, an Investor Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling up to 12,600 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹1.70 crore, if all offered shares are sold; the money is already in hand.
Their retained 42,000 shares, valued at ₹3.97 crore at offer price, are unlocked since 9 Sep 2026 and could mean more money later.
Share sale is recent, but it happened 67 days ago; the shares-not-cash status and pricing discount for employee-portion shares are noted.
